column1: # Game profile of Gal Guardians: Demon Purge (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.1.0 = v262144).
# Inti Creates "Ice" engine on NVN, SDK 14.3.0; modules main + subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_movie) + subsdk1 (GLSLC runtime compiler) + sdk.
# RomFS: Common/ and NX/ hashed asset directories (Inti Creates IceRes resource tree: TEX, OSB, SSBP, BFB, SFB, etc.), MP4 movies in NX/, TGA capture overlay.
# Shaders: main holds 7 GLSL sources compiled at run time via GLSLC in subsdk1 (captured via runtime device_glslc or host GLSLC capture into glslc_capture/).
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie, subsdk1 = GLSLC)
# The NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game sets a heap of at most the pool - 64 MB (3328 MB heap region)
